observations: L04: فاُضرِبْه is one word (the rā' does not join the following letter; a sukun over the bā'). L04 تِلْقاءَ and L03 تِلْقاءَهُ have a sukun over the lām.
L14: «واوتر» as printed: a free-standing alif (1.7 x 9.1 pt) where the article of والوتر has its lām, and a small dot (1.6 x 1.8 pt) over the gap after it.
L17: «بتلوه» as printed: one dot under the first letter, two over the second (the sense requires يتلوه, as on L14).

L06, L14, L17: فزدْه and فزدْته have a sukun over the dāl and no kasra; فزده on L22 has no vowel sign; L13 فاُقسمه has no kasra, L05 فاُقسِمْه a kasra and a sukun; L01 اكْثَرَ a sukun over the kāf (measured).
L03, L11: in تِلْقاءَهُ and تلقاءَه the hamza and a fatha over it are one sort (3.6 x 4.3 and 3.2 x 4.7 pt), as in تلقاءَ (L01) and تِلْقاءَ (L04).
